1.normal: no phase, and no output movement

comment: Knob and CV multiply rather than add: the knob gives a factor and the CV gives two to the power of its voltage, and the product is rounded to a whole number when it is above one, or to one over a whole number when it is below, then clamped to 199 (Div.cpp:83-90). The knob has no printed scale; the display carries the number.
